description: This file defines the MetricsFactory class, a thread-safe factory for creating and managing Metrics instances within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to create Metrics from XML elements or direct parameters, handles caching, and defines inner implementations for Metrics, including a null object pattern. The class also includes utility methods for retrieving metrics by name and listing all metrics.

classes.name: MetricsImpl
classes.description: Private implementation of the Metrics interface, providing functionality for recording service rates, resetting metrics, and comparison based on metrics name.

classes.name: NullMetrics
classes.description: Private class implementing Metrics that acts as a no-operation placeholder.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a Metrics instance from an XML element, caching based on the metric name, and reading configuration attributes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Metrics instance with specified parameters, caching based on the metric name.

methods.name: getMetric
methods.description: Retrieves an existing Metrics instance by name.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Returns a collection of all Metrics instances, sorted by name.
